item.title: An experimental self-host website
item.description: We installed our first NAS in our network on May 25. Since its installation, despite it being capable of humble 2 TB-storage, I cannot stop thinking of what we can do with the storage on server. The first thing came to my mind is to run a self-host website. I have always wanted to build a website without permissions from any third-party providers or some sort of subscription to make my MPV work.

item.title: Installation of NAS at home from an old laptop
item.description: My wife and I have some old laptops that had been obsolete for more than 6 years. To keep them away from dust, we placed them deep in the storage cabinet, which made taking up space their only functionality. We have recently identified our strong need for shared storage within our network for we have constantly looking for possibilities of file sharing and data management from time to time. I had known that NAS is probably what can be of huge help.
